setup_summary.effective_lagrangian: L_eff = L_GR + L_K + L_Sent + L_mix; L_K ~ -(1/2) dK_bg^2, L_Sent ~ relaxation(Sent(Y)), L_mix ~ eta * Sent(Y) * K_bg

continuous_symmetry_summary: Diffeomorphisms are preserved at the effective level; no exact internal U(1) or KT rotation symmetry is generated by the mix term.
discrete_symmetry_summary: The effective mix term breaks exact Y -> -Y and (K, T) -> (-K, -T) invariances, so discrete symmetries are classified as absent rather than contradictory.
geometric_symmetry_summary: Sent(Y) keeps its effective relaxation form under D1/D2-like shifts of the asymptotic level, and K/T rescalings are absorbed into weak coupling redefinitions.
conserved_quantities_summary: At the effective level, the model retains covariant conservation from diffeomorphism invariance and an identifiable geometric charge associated with the K sector.
